Method of Attack: Data-stealing capabilities targeting web browsers, email clients, remote admin tools (SSH, VNC, RDP), and clipboard data
Collecting information about documents on the system
Monitoring user keystrokes to extract sensitive details
Delivered via ISO image files attached to spam emails using wire payment document ruse
Anti-reversing techniques including IsDebuggerPresent() function and virtual machine detection via timing differences between CloseHandle() and GetProcessHeap()
Impacted Systems: Modern operating systems that auto-mount ISO files
Systems with web browsers, email clients, remote admin tools (SSH, VNC, RDP)
Attack Vector: Email attachments containing small ISO image files (1MB to 2MB)
Indicators of Compromise: ISO image files sized 1MB to 2MB containing a single executable malware payload
Spam email message text: 'Apologies for the delay, but please find attached a copy of the wire payment for the overdue invoice'
Signatures mimicking real company details including address, website, and contact information
